title: Design tab reads /design/read through an exact-key decoder
description:

The opened goal shows a Design tab with the five sections and the version. Skip path: a goal with DESIGN_REVISION_ABSENT (or equivalent) shows words that the step was skipped or no design exists, not a blank tab.

(1) live-design.test.ts modelled on live-goal-source.test.ts: mapDesignAnswer maps an exact success frame (keys from step 1) including a dataModel entity named e.g. Order; extra key -> ERROR DESIGN_RESPONSE_INVALID; missing key -> same; DESIGN_REVISION_ABSENT {code, layer} or {code, layer, outcome:REFUSED} -> REFUSED with that code AND layer; listener {code:LISTENER_DESIGN_UNAVAILABLE, layer:CONTROL_ROOM_LISTENER} -> REFUSED. readDesign posts exactly JSON.stringify({ goalRef }) to /design/read.

(2) design-card.test.tsx: success renders version and the entity name Order (DoD 2/3); DESIGN_REVISION_ABSENT renders words that there is no design (not a blank card); other refusals use OutcomeNote with code and layer; loading copy while null. Apostrophe-free JSX.

(3) live-document-proxy.test.ts: add `/design/read` to the hard-coded list in the SAME place as DEV_PROXY_PATHS will get it (after `/goals/source/read`).

Run `pnpm --filter @moe/control-room test` and quote the reds.
